description: 3-stage SSRF via redirect-following migration from urlopen to requests: (1) image-proxy endpoint validates hostname against allowlist, fetches via urllib.request.urlopen (no redirects by default), (2) add content-length + timeout + retry logic, (3) swap to requests.get for connection pooling and retry ergonomics. requests.get defaults to following redirects — attacker's allowed-origin server responds with HTTP 302 to 169.254.169.254, fetched without re-validation.
